item.title: 【環境】 Scalable ambient fabrication of single-junction and perovskite–silicon tandem solar cells
item.description: Practical application of perovskite solar cells requires scalable fabrication in ambient environments. Here the authors introduce PNCC, a hole-transport co-polymer that enables ambient-fabricated devices to achieve certified efficiencies of 33.0% in tandem cells and 23.2% in modules.
